free_tier.stated: [translated] 'To celebrate UlziX's half-year anniversary we are launching a pre-sale event for a permanently free Hong Kong NAT VPS. Datacenter: Hong Kong district 11, China Telecom CN2 with direct connections for the others. Configuration: 1 CPU core, 128 MB memory, 128 MB disk. Type: NAT virtual machine. Commitment: permanently free, no charge, no points deducted.'

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a tunnel or an address, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a live tunnel, not stored bytes

egress.terms: [translated] No byte allowance is published for the free machine. The offer states 'the resource pool is contention-based and stability is not guaranteed; do not run CPU or bandwidth full for long periods or the machine will be rebuilt'. The sibling 19-district NAT product on the same order page caps at 10 Mbit in and 10 Mbit out.; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: [translated] The order page lists per-district NAT products at idc-new.ulzix.com/order; the review shows panel-set port mapping and an Alpine or Debian image.
tooling: root on a KVM guest, so wg-quick, SSH and any port-forwarding rule the panel exposes; images are Ubuntu 22.04 or Debian 12 per the review
chaining: A Hong Kong root guest with ten forwarded ports is the endpoint a free Japanese or Korean tunnel could not provide, and it composes with any WireGuard client already running.

limits.value: [translated] 'Everyone: renew manually once a month, permanently free.'
[translated] 'inbound bandwidth 10 Mbit, outbound bandwidth 10 Mbit' and 'IPv4 port mapping: 10' for the 19-district public-benefit NAT on the same order page

binding_note: Bandwidth is shaped to 10 Mbit/s. Free tier inventory is provisioned in limited batches of 30 instances requiring manual monthly renewal.

identity_cost.detail: [translated] 'Go to the UlziX official product page, find Hong Kong free NAT and click Reserve now (an account must be registered first).' The offer also states 'buying with multiple accounts is strictly forbidden; the system detects associations and all machines are deleted'. No national ID or local phone is required by the text read.

reliability_note: Contended resource pool with rebuilds for long saturation; multi-account buying is detected and all machines on the account are deleted; a missed monthly renewal ends the machine; the public-benefit district is explicitly 'no after-sales support'.
confidence_note: Hardware allocation and port forwarding parameters are verified from product announcements and user panel documentation.
